description: Ask coach interrupts a measured correction; explicitly repeated teaching plays while paused, then Resume cancels that teaching and counts only fresh observations.
oracle: Measured sag audio must play just before Ask and stop within 250ms. Paused help cannot add held time. Repeat must start real teaching audio, and Resume must stop it within 250ms without restarting obsolete correction. Synthetic landmarks, actual recorded clips, not microphone or speaker validation.

description: Pause interrupts an audible form correction, stays silent, then explicitly resumes with fresh observations.
oracle: Actual sag audio must play immediately before Pause and stop within 250ms. No speech starts while paused, held time freezes, and no stale sag correction starts after recovery. Synthetic input, real recorded-clip output; not physical speaker validation.

description: A user selects unassessed follow-along during a measured hip correction. Old correction stops, teaching plays, absent observations create no further corrections.
oracle: Actual recorded sag audio must start before the choice and be silent within 250ms after it. Only new teaching may start in follow-along; no form, praise or readiness speech. This is synthetic playback, not human exercise/clothing validation.

description: Actual coach playback during a stable plank, sustained synthetic hip sag, recovery and tracking loss.
oracle: The authored hip translation is a controlled fault, not human ground truth. Speech must belong to the current phase, fit its TTL and never overlap another clip. Repetition and unsupported praise are review candidates.

description: A beginner skips Plank while its teaching audio is playing, then stops the session.
oracle: After skipping, newly started speech must not describe the abandoned movement. Speech already playing at skip is a separate stale-speech review candidate. Stop must stop actual playback.

description: No body is visible for 24 seconds; inspect how often visibility instructions are actually spoken.
oracle: No body means no arming, form praise or rep count. Repeated visibility instructions are flagged for human review, not silently accepted as good coaching.

description: A real long teaching clip blocks a correction until that correction is obsolete.
oracle: The correction has an explicit 200ms TTL and must not start after it expires. This drives the real Coach directly; it is not an engine-generated correction.
